experiment.selection_rule: User priority: preserve original clean performance. Eligible only if mean clean capture-7 deployed EER is no worse than baseline (numerical tolerance 1e-12). Among eligible candidates minimize mean deployed EER equally weighted over DB and noise sigma0/5/10/20, averaging 3 fixed nonzero-noise realizations. Tie by clean EER then smaller training noise max. Capture8 never selects the level. Also preserve capture7 clean deployed EER separately for each DB.

production_decision.reason: User prioritizes original performance: adopt the locked candidate only if capture8 clean EER is also non-worse in every DB. Otherwise retain the fixed original baseline; never select another level using capture8.
